messages:
Olivia (AE): Heads up: BetaCorp wants a lightweight 2-week POC. Requirements: hosted API keys, a small Dedicated reserve for burst, and a VPC peering smoke. Can we map owners + a short checklist?
Jon (SE): I can do infra. Minimal checklist I use:
- Create scoped POC API key (`beta-poc`) TTL=14d
- Open ops ticket for small Dedicated commit (1 GPU equiv) with auto-release 14d
- Configure routing: prefer Dedicated -> fallback Hosted
- Prep VPC peering steps and exchange CIDRs
Priya (Solutions): I'll handle security answers: SSO (SAML), KMS/BYOK, audit logs, retention, and PHI/PII gating. Flag if they plan to send sensitive data -> require Private review.
Nina (Product): Pricing: Hosted-only is usage. Dedicated adds prorated reserved fee + possible setup one-time. Send QPS + avg prompt and I'll give a sticker band. We sometimes offer a short POC discount.
Olivia (AE): Can someone paste a short smoke test and the ops ticket format I should expect?
Jon (SE): Smoke test (10 prompts recommended). Simple curl to validate generate + failover:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize: Hello BetaCorp","model":"redwood-1"}'
```
Jon (SE): Ops ticket format I file: `OPS: POC - <Customer> - Dedicated request` with fields: customer_name, contact, duration, gpu_type, qps_est, model_family, fallback_policy, expiration_date, SJQ attached. I set auto-release on expiration_date.
Priya (Solutions): VPC checklist: exchange customer CIDR, provide our peer IPs, open outbound 443, confirm if they need static egress for allowlist, exchange SAML metadata if they want console SSO.
Olivia (AE): Demo failover procedure? Want a one-pager to hand to BetaCorp.
Jon (SE): Demo steps: 1) Point traffic to Dedicated endpoint using POC key 2) Simulate pool drain (set commit to 0) 3) Confirm calls succeed against Hosted fallback within SLO and outputs match baseline on the 10-prompt suite. Capture logs + request IDs for trace.
Nina (Product): Also pin model family and sampling params in routing rule to reduce regression risk. Run eval harness pre/post-failover to compare.
eng-oncall-bot: Ticket POC-1851234567 created by Jon (SE)  assigned to infra-team.
Olivia (AE): Perfect. Next steps: Jon opens ticket (done), Priya posts compact security answers here, Nina sends price band after QPS, Olivia to collect IdP metadata if requested. Please confirm.
Jon (SE): Confirmed.
Priya (Solutions): Confirmed  I'll post answers within the hour.
Nina (Product): Confirmed, will DM pricing after QPS.
Olivia (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
